method: Matched firmware trace records to plugin motor packets by exact four-channel uint16 ratio tuple; tuples listed below are unique in the retained plugin stream. Gazebo telemetry is selected by capture_monotonic_time_ns proximity. This aligns output events, not the source IMU sample consumed by that firmware iteration.
host_clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC nanoseconds captured independently by the plugin and host sampler.
limitations: Firmware sensor sample source timestamp/sequence is absent; exact consumed IMU age is unknown.
Gazebo and firmware filtered gyro values are close in wall-clock capture time but cannot be asserted to describe the same source measurement.
Other Gazebo processes were active. This evidence prioritizes a sensor-provenance investigation; it does not prove stale data or a conversion defect.
